subject.title: fix(plugins): make llm_input hook abortable and fail-closed

question: Should `llm_input` remain the shipped observation-only telemetry hook, with prompt policy enforcement continuing exclusively through `before_agent_run`?
rationale: This PR changes a public plugin API's execution, failure, latency, and security semantics; choosing a second permanent prompt-gating contract requires explicit owner intent rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Keep one policy gate
options.body: Close or rework this PR so policy plugins use `before_agent_run` and `llm_input` remains non-blocking observation.

options.title: Design an opt-in gate
options.body: If per-provider-payload gating is genuinely required, introduce an explicitly named or opted-in contract with bounded execution, sanitization, migration documentation, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Accept the semantic break
options.body: Make `llm_input` fail-closed globally and explicitly own the resulting observer compatibility, latency, logging, and upgrade impact.

recommendation.title: Keep one policy gate
recommendation.body: Close or rework this PR so policy plugins use `before_agent_run` and `llm_input` remains non-blocking observation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent plugin hook contract and registry work makes this the best available owner for the public API direction.
